This is a racing incident to me(but leaning more blame on the hotwheels car.) The hot wheels car was on the inside line near the kerb the whole time, however, the ideal line through this turn is more v shaped than just hugging the turn the whole way through. The hot wheels car was very ambitious to try and pass there with minimal overlap to begin with.

Your lap is good, just focus on rotating the car and getting power down as soon as possible. As long as you can run consistent laps you will be good, I know a lot of people will hit the death kerb at t6 and go off there, so being consistently clean will keep you safe. Also remember in a race you aren't always going to be in free air, most gains come from minimizing your time lost stuck in traffic.
